svg.title: Chromosome 2 fusion schematic
svg.desc: Two ancestral acrocentric chromosomes fuse at their short-arm telomeres. Their banded material is concatenated into one continuous dicentric body with only two outer telomere caps. All three fused stages retain the same material, length and band positions. The lower centromere becomes inactive, shown by a dashed rectangular collar; the final stage replaces that collar with continuing chromosome material. Solid rectangular collars mark active centromeres. Band lengths are illustration coordinates, not a measured cytogenetic map.
